standard.boundary: public NumberField.maximal_order() on a fresh field in a warmed persistent Sage.js worker
standard.uniformity: All 489 standard cases use exactly this retained request policy.

worker_recovery.replacement: Every timeout kills and fully reaps its process group; the following case uses a newly spawned worker.
worker_recovery.separation: Initial/replacement-worker prime rows are retained in worker_recovery_records and never substitute for a standard row.

longer_diagnostics.selection: Every standard case whose uniform row is timeout
longer_diagnostics.separation: Diagnostic rows are retained separately and never replace or relabel the uniform 5000 ms row.

stress.public_execution: not run; the corpus marks these 16 large cases opt-in
stress.boundary: bounded structural/oracle verification of checked frozen metadata
stress.limitation: All 16 stress bases are digest-only; current public containment, multiplication closure, and lattice equality are not claimed.
